The fluid the Pumpjack extracts, as a fluid ID. Defaults to stellaris:oil. The Fuel Refinery and the oil slots accept any fluid in the c:oil tag.
Settings related to how much energy Stellaris produces, stores and consumes.

Multiplies every Stellaris energy value: generator output, machine and item costs, storage capacities and cable throughput. Ratios between them stay the same. Changes apply to machines when they are next loaded.
